invariant: GraphvizImageBuilder mutates a directly empty package group to EMPTY_PACKAGE. For an ordinary package with no explicit USymbol, GeneralImageBuilder selects EntityImageEmptyPackage. Its drawU constructs ClusterDecoration with getSkinParam().packageStyle() and a null symbol, so ClusterDecoration.guess applies the configured packageStyle geometry. The leaf's style and colors remain those calculated by EntityImageEmptyPackage; the fallback selects shape and shape-specific dimensions, not a different semantic entity kind.
causal_divergence: Rust intentionally restricted empty-leaf symbol_kind and dimensions to automatic_package_kind, based on the predecessor account's false assumption that packageStyle affected clusters only. The independent checker generated a valid ordinary directly empty package under packageStyle cloud: Java paints and sizes a cloud leaf, while Rust keeps ordinary folder chrome. The filled ordinary package control follows the separate cluster path.
planned_change: For directly empty ordinary package leaves, select geometry and shape-specific dimensions from automatic_package_kind first and configured_package_kind second, matching ClusterDecoration.guess. Retain package semantic style lookup and explicit colors. Keep explicit/automatic symbol precedence and do not turn the leaf into a painted cluster.
